meta.review_notes: Verification fetch returned the Microsoft privacy landing page instead of the full Privacy Statement. Category ratings rely on prior verified excerpts from the actual statement. Unsupported claims were removed and language tightened to strict legal-safe standards.

app.name: Microsoft Word
app.description: The mobile version of Microsoft's word-processing app for creating, editing, and sharing documents, with cloud sync via OneDrive and AI-powered Copilot features.

verdict.one_liner: Word may share your data with advertisers and process documents on Microsoft cloud servers.
verdict.summary: Microsoft Word requires a Microsoft account and collects data including your name, email, contacts, device identifiers, and usage information. Microsoft states it may share data with third-party advertising platforms and advertisers. Documents stored in OneDrive or processed by connected experiences are sent to Microsoft's cloud. On the positive side, Microsoft states it does not use your documents, emails, or photos to target ads. However, the verification fetch returned a landing page rather than the full Privacy Statement, so the analysis relies on prior verified excerpts.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Microsoft states it may share your data with advertising platforms and collect device identifiers and usage data. The verification fetch could not retrieve the full Privacy Statement for re-verification.

red.title: Shares data with ad platforms
red.plain_english: Microsoft states it may share data with third-party advertising platforms and advertisers to deliver and measure ads.

red.title: May collect contacts for sharing
red.plain_english: Microsoft states it may collect contacts and relationships data from sharing, contact management, and communication features.

red.title: Collects device identifiers and usage data
red.plain_english: Microsoft states it collects hardware and software info, IP address, device identifiers such as IMEI, and nearby network data.

red.title: Policy changes without active consent
red.plain_english: Microsoft states it may update the privacy statement, and if you disagree, you must stop using the Services and close your Microsoft account.

green.title: No content-based ad targeting
green.plain_english: Microsoft states it does not use your email, chat, video calls, documents, photos, or other personal files to target ads.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Microsoft states it does not use your documents, photos, or voice content to target ads.
categories.detail: The policy does not explicitly describe camera or microphone access, but states content is not used for ad targeting.
categories.policy_excerpt: Microsoft does not use what you say in email, human-to-human chat, video calls, or voice mail, or your documents, photos, or other personal files to target ads.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Microsoft states it may collect precise location data like GPS, or imprecise location such as your city or postal code from your IP address.
categories.detail: Coarse location collected via IP. The App Store label lists 'Coarse Location' for analytics.
categories.policy_excerpt: Location data — Precise location data like GPS or imprecise location data such as your city or postal code derived from your IP address.
concerns: Coarse location collected even without explicit GPS permission

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Microsoft states it may collect contacts and relationships data from sharing, contact management, and communication features.
categories.detail: Contacts collected for app functionality. The policy does not explicitly say they are uploaded to servers or linked to your identity.
categories.policy_excerpt: Contacts and relationships — data from sharing, contact management, and communication features.
concerns: Contacts are linked to your identity rather than anonymized

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Microsoft states it may collect content such as files, emails, photos, and documents stored or processed via Microsoft cloud services.
categories.detail: Document content processed on Microsoft cloud servers when using OneDrive or connected experiences.
categories.policy_excerpt: Content — Files, communications, emails, photos, songs, documents, and other media stored or processed via Microsoft cloud services.
concerns: Document content processed on Microsoft cloud servers
Connected experiences may send document content to Microsoft

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Microsoft states it may share data with third-party advertising platforms and advertisers to deliver and measure ads.
categories.detail: The policy states data may be shared with third-party advertising platforms and advertisers.
categories.policy_excerpt: Data may be shared with third party advertising platforms and advertisers to facilitate the delivery and measurement of ads.
concerns: Data shared with advertising platforms
Data shared with unspecified vendors and agents
Corporate transaction data sharing clause
Push notification data sent to third-party providers on non-Windows devices

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Microsoft states it collects your name, email, postal address, phone number, and similar contact details, plus passwords and security information for authentication.
categories.detail: Standard account information for authentication and app functionality.
categories.policy_excerpt: Name and contact data — First/last name, email, postal address, phone number, and similar contact details. Credentials — Passwords, password hints, and security information used for authentication.
concerns: Account data linked across entire Microsoft ecosystem
Work/school accounts give organization access to your data

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Microsoft states it may use data from your interactions to deliver relevant advertising, and collects online activity data for interest-based ads.
categories.detail: Product interaction and browsing data may be used for ad personalization.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may use data from interactions and our first-party and third-party properties to deliver relevant advertising. Interest-based advertising — Collecting online activity data to deliver relevant ads.
concerns: Product interaction data linked to your identity
Cross-device advertising profile
Interest inference from browsing behavior
Opt-out doesn't stop data collection

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Microsoft states its products either block underage users or require parental consent for users under 13.
categories.detail: Age requirement exists but enforcement mechanism is not described.
categories.policy_excerpt: For users under 13 (or the age specified by local law), Microsoft products either block underage users or require parental consent/authorization.
concerns: 4+ App Store rating inconsistent with 13+ account requirement
No robust age verification in the app itself

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Microsoft states it collects hardware and software info, IP address, device identifiers such as IMEI, and nearby network data.
categories.detail: IP and network data collected for security and analytics.
categories.policy_excerpt: Device and usage data — Hardware/software info, product keys, IP address, device identifiers (e.g., IMEI), nearby network data.
concerns: IP-based location inference
Push notification data shared with third-party providers

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Microsoft states it collects hardware and software info, IP address, device identifiers such as IMEI, and nearby network data.
categories.detail: Device identifiers collected for analytics and app functionality.
categories.policy_excerpt: Device and usage data — Hardware/software info, product keys, IP address, device identifiers (e.g., IMEI), nearby network data.
concerns: Unique device identifiers created for tracking
Cross-device tracking via MUID cookie and advertising ID
Diagnostic data includes app usage patterns

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Microsoft states it may collect biometric data such as facial or fingerprint recognition, with consent, for services like Windows Hello.
categories.detail: The policy mentions Windows Hello biometrics, not iOS Face ID. Biometric authentication on iOS is handled locally by the device.
categories.policy_excerpt: Biometric data and identifiers — Physical, physiological, or behavioral characteristics for identification (e.g., Windows Hello facial/fingerprint recognition), collected with consent.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Microsoft states it collects payment instrument numbers and subscription/licensing data.
categories.detail: Payment and subscription data collected for in-app purchases and licensing.
categories.policy_excerpt: Payment data — Payment instrument numbers and associated security codes. Subscription and licensing data — Information about subscriptions, licenses, and entitlements.
concerns: Microsoft collects subscription and licensing data even when Apple processes the payment

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: Microsoft states it retains personal data as long as needed for the stated purposes, and deletes or de-identifies it when no longer needed.
categories.detail: Retention tied to purpose. Some data may be kept longer if required by law.
categories.policy_excerpt: Microsoft retains personal data for the period needed to fulfill the purposes outlined in the statement, unless a longer retention period is required by law. When data is no longer needed, it is deleted or de-identified.
concerns: 60-day waiting period for account deletion
Some data retained after deletion for legal/business reasons
Not all data types can be deleted through the dashboard

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Microsoft states it may update the privacy statement, and if you disagree, you must stop using the Services and close your account.
categories.detail: No advance notice mechanism described beyond encouraging periodic review.
categories.policy_excerpt: Microsoft may update this privacy statement. You are encouraged to review this privacy statement periodically. If you disagree, you must stop using the Services, close your Microsoft account.
concerns: No advance notice required for policy changes
Continued use equals consent
No option to reject changes while keeping the account
